intro.title: Session Timeout Hook
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a reusable Vue composable called `useSessionTimeout` that automatically logs a user out after a period of inactivity. You will learn how to use Vue's Composition API to create custom hooks that manage state and side effects. The main technologies involved are Vue 3's `ref`, `onMounted`, `onUnmounted`, and browser events like `mousemove` and `keydown`. By the end, you'll have a practical hook that enhances application security by handling session timeouts.
intro.usecase: Session timeout hooks are essential in security-sensitive applications where user inactivity could compromise data. In banking dashboards, they automatically log users out after periods of inactivity to prevent unauthorized access to financial information. E-commerce admin panels use them to protect order management systems, while healthcare portals implement them to maintain patient data confidentiality under HIPAA regulations. Developers add these hooks to any application handling sensitive user data or transactions.
